title: Integration Launchers
summary: This module orchestrates the launch, configuration, and management of various external integrations, ensuring proper setup, model selection, and user interaction for tools like Cline, Codex, Hermes, and Kimi.

nodes.label: CLI Commands
nodes.title: CLI Commands

nodes.label: Configure Integrations
nodes.title: Configure Integrations
